theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Staples (+1.16%) and Communication Svcs (+1.05%) led the market today, while Technology (-2.69%) and Materials (-0.62%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -0.65% versus +0.45% for defensives and -0.11% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.49%, Dow +0.01%, Nasdaq -0.91% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.50%. The VIX rose 3.00% to 19.25, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.83% to $3,884.70, crude oil was little changed at $88.74, and bitcoin slipped 3.52% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
